title: 2026 UK ETS HSE bankable-target QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for hospital or small emitters: how to comply
UK ETS Hospital and Small Emitter status

facts.fact: When reportable emissions are below the annual HSE emissions target, the difference is the bankable amount.
The regulator may increase the following year's emissions target by the bankable amount and vary the permit accordingly.
For a small-emitter HSE, banking cannot increase the target above 24,999 tonnes CO2e.
If the emissions target is based on estimated emissions, the bankable amount is zero.
Banking does not carry between allocation periods.
A bankable amount in 2025 does not increase the 2026 emissions target.
Banking uses reportable emissions rather than an inferred physical or parcel estimate.
A banking adjustment is reflected through regulator variation of the HSE permit.
An operator-calculated difference is not itself an approved target increase.
These banking rules apply to HSE target compliance, not the main-scheme allowance-surrender calculation.

guard_patterns.rule: Keep HSE target banking distinct from main scheme.
Do not convert regulator discretion into automatic increase.
Preserve zero bankable amount for estimated targets.
Do not bank across allocation periods.
